The Vibium MCP server exposes 92 tools. This page lists each
one with its parameters, as reported by the server's own `tools/list`.
The raw schemas are published as [`/mcp-tools.json`](/mcp-tools.json).

Tools marked **(nightly)** are not in the latest release (26.8.21);
see [What's in Nightly](../nightly.md). To register the server, see
[Client Setup](setup.md).

## Parameters

### `vibium_run`

> **Nightly only.** Not in the latest release.

Accomplish a goal in the current local browser session using configured AI provider and constrained browser tools. Returns completed or not_completed with evidence. Live only; uses VIBIUM_AI_* configuration.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aiBaseURL` | string | no | Per-call override for the AI provider's API base URL (the model endpoint, not the site under test). Changing provider clears it. Credentials come from the runtime environment. |
| `baseURL` | string | no | Site under test: opened first unless the current page already shares its origin, and relative browser_navigate paths resolve against it. Not the AI provider endpoint; that is aiBaseURL. |
| `goal` | string | yes |  |
| `model` | string | no | Per-call model setting override. Changing provider clears inherited model, endpoint, and reasoning effort. Credentials come from the runtime environment. |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `provider` | string | no | Per-call model setting override. Changing provider clears inherited model, endpoint, and reasoning effort. Credentials come from the runtime environment. |
| `reasoningEffort` | string | no | Per-call model setting override. Changing provider clears inherited model, endpoint, and reasoning effort. Credentials come from the runtime environment. |

### `vibium_check`

> **Nightly only.** Not in the latest release.

Independently verify an explicit claim against the current local Chrome/Firefox session, or a read-only recording zip. Returns passed, failed, or inconclusive with evidence. Recorded mode never launches a browser. Uses shared AI configuration from the server environment.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aiBaseURL` | string | no | Per-call override for the AI provider's API base URL (the model endpoint, not the site under test). Changing provider clears it. Credentials come from the runtime environment. |
| `baseURL` | string | no | Site under test: opened first unless the current page already shares its origin, and relative browser_navigate paths resolve against it. Not the AI provider endpoint; that is aiBaseURL. |
| `claim` | string | yes |  |
| `model` | string | no | Per-call model setting override. Changing provider clears inherited model, endpoint, and reasoning effort. Credentials come from the runtime environment. |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `provider` | string | no | Per-call model setting override. Changing provider clears inherited model, endpoint, and reasoning effort. Credentials come from the runtime environment. |
| `reasoningEffort` | string | no | Per-call model setting override. Changing provider clears inherited model, endpoint, and reasoning effort. Credentials come from the runtime environment. |
| `record` | string | no | Optional path to an existing version 8 Vibium record.zip or Playwright trace.zip on this host; selects archive mode instead of the live browser. |

### `vibium_say`

> **Nightly only.** Not in the latest release.

Speak text into the target. The default is the current session: the phone on a Roadie, or the page's microphone in a browser. With no session open it is this machine's speakers. Returns when playback ends.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cache` | boolean | no | false renders again instead of replaying cached audio |
| `cacheDir` | string | no | Where rendered audio is kept |
| `file` | string | no | A WAV file to play as it is, in place of text |
| `language` | string | no |  |
| `model` | string | no |  |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `provider` | string | no | Text-to-speech provider or preset; the default comes from the server environment |
| `speed` | number | no |  |
| `target` | string | no | session, local, or a path ending in .wav |
| `text` | string | no | What to say. Give text or file |
| `voice` | string | no |  |

### `vibium_listen`

> **Nightly only.** Not in the latest release.

Listen to the target and return what was said. The default is the current session: what the phone or the page plays. With no session open it is this machine's microphone. Hears from the end of the last vibium_say, so a reply that began before this call is not missed. Stops after trailing silence.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allowSilence` | boolean | no | Return an empty transcript instead of an error when nothing is heard |
| `duration` | number | no | Maximum capture length from this call, in ms (default 30000) |
| `language` | string | no |  |
| `model` | string | no |  |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `path` | string | no | Also save the captured audio as a WAV file |
| `provider` | string | no | Speech-to-text provider or preset; the default comes from the server environment |
| `silence` | number | no | Trailing silence that ends the reply, in ms (default 1000). 0 turns endpointing off |
| `target` | string | no | session, local, or a path ending in .wav |
| `timeout` | number | no | How long to wait for speech to start, from this call, in ms (default 10000) |
| `transcribe` | boolean | no | false captures without a transcript; speech onset and reply latency are still measured |

Start a browser session

### `browser_type`

Type text into an element by CSS selector, or, with no selector, into whatever has focus. With a selector, waits for the element to be visible, stable, enabled, and editable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `selector` | string | no | CSS selector for the element to type into. Omit it to type into the focused element, or on a device with no DOM. |
| `text` | string | yes | The text to type |
| `timeout` | number | no | Timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000) |

### `browser_find`

Find one element and register it as an @eN ref for later tools. Give a natural-language description, a reference image, or an exact locator: css (a CSS selector), tag, or a semantic locator (role, text, label, placeholder, testid, xpath, alt, title); role combines with text and the others. A description is matched against the page's names and roles first; when that is not enough and an AI provider is configured, the screenshot goes to a vision model. An image is matched locally first and only then, if a provider is configured, sent to the model with the screenshot. Explicit locators never call a model.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aiBaseURL` | string | no | AI provider base URL override for this call |
| `alt` | string | no | Find element by alt attribute |
| `css` | string | no | CSS selector; exact, never sent to a model. Next to a semantic locator it restricts the candidates |
| `description` | string | no | Natural-language description of the element, e.g. "the Add to Cart button". Stands alone. |
| `details` | boolean | no | Include diagnostics: method, whether a model was called, provider and model, raw scores |
| `image` | string | no | Reference image as base64 PNG or JPEG (a data: URL is accepted), up to 4 MB. Stands alone. Matched locally; see strategy. |
| `label` | string | no | Find input by associated label text or aria-label |
| `model` | string | no | Model override for this call; a vision-capable model |
| `name` | string | no | Accessible name filter: the text, label, alt, or aria-label a person would read the element by |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `placeholder` | string | no | Find element by placeholder attribute |
| `provider` | string | no | AI provider override for this call (same as vibium_check) |
| `reasoningEffort` | string | no | Reasoning effort override for this call |
| `role` | string | no | ARIA role to match (e.g., "button", "link", "textbox", "heading", "checkbox") |
| `selector` | string | no | Same as css |
| `strategy` | string: `auto`, `cv`, `vlm`, `tree` | no | auto (default): local evidence first, a vision model only when needed and configured. cv: local image matching only, nothing leaves the machine. vlm: vision model only; needs a configured provider. tree: the page's DOM/accessibility tree only |
| `tag` | string | no | HTML tag name, e.g. "h1" |
| `testid` | string | no | Find element by data-testid attribute |
| `text` | string | no | Find element containing this text |
| `timeout` | number | no | Timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000) |
| `title` | string | no | Find element by title attribute |
| `xpath` | string | no | Find element by XPath expression |

| `limit` | number | no | Maximum number of elements to return (default: 10) |

| `name` | string | no | Accessible name filter: the text, label, alt, or aria-label a person would read the element by |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |

| `provider` | string | no | AI provider override for this call (same as vibium_check) |

| `xpath` | string | no | Find element by XPath expression |

### `browser_evaluate`

Execute JavaScript in the browser to extract data, query the DOM, or inspect page state. Returns the evaluated result. Use this to get text content, attributes, element data, or any information from the page.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expression` | string | yes | JavaScript expression to evaluate |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |

### `browser_stop`

Stop the browser session

No parameters.

### `browser_get_html`

Get the HTML content of the page or a specific element

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outer` | boolean | no | Return outerHTML instead of innerHTML (default: false) |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `selector` | string | no | CSS selector for a specific element (optional, defaults to full page HTML) |

### `browser_wait`

Wait for an element to reach a specified state (attached, visible, or hidden)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `selector` | string | yes | CSS selector for the element to wait for |
| `state` | string: `attached`, `visible`, `hidden` | no | State to wait for: "attached" (exists in DOM), "visible" (visible on page), or "hidden" (not found or not visible) |
| `timeout` | number | no | Timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000) |

### `browser_swipe`

> **Nightly only.** Not in the latest release.

Swipe a touch pointer, finger held down for the move (for touchscreen devices and phones). Give a direction, or x1, y1, x2, y2. A direction swipe starts at the viewport center, or at an edge with from, and moves half the viewport unless distance says otherwise. On a phone through Roadie, from: bottom with direction: up goes home, from: top with direction: down opens Notification Center or the notification shade, and from: top-right with direction: down opens Control Center on an iPhone

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | string: `up`, `down`, `left`, `right` | no | Which way the finger moves. Instead of x1, y1, x2, y2 |
| `distance` | number | no | How far a direction swipe moves, in pixels (default: half the viewport) |
| `duration` | number | no | How long the move takes in milliseconds (default: 300) |
| `from` | string: `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`, `top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-left`, `bottom-right`, `center` | no | Where a direction swipe starts: an edge or corner of the viewport, or its center (default) |
| `fromX` | number | no | X coordinate a direction swipe starts at, with fromY. Instead of from |
| `fromY` | number | no | Y coordinate a direction swipe starts at, with fromX |
| `hold` | number | no | Milliseconds the finger rests at the end before lifting (a slow swipe up from the bottom with a hold opens the app switcher) |
| `page` | string | no | Page id (from browser_new_page or browser_list_pages) that pins this call to that page instead of the globally current one. Concurrent callers sharing this server should create their own page and pass its id on every call. |
| `speed` | string or number | no | slow, normal, fast, or pixels per second. Instead of duration |
| `x1` | number | no | X coordinate to start from |
| `x2` | number | no | X coordinate to end at |
| `y1` | number | no | Y coordinate to start from |
| `y2` | number | no | Y coordinate to end at |

### `browser_record_start`

Start a browser recording (screenshots and/or HTML snapshots). Output is Playwright trace viewer compatible.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bidi` | boolean | no | Record raw BiDi commands in the recording (default: false) |
| `format` | string: `jpeg`, `png` | no | Screenshot format: "jpeg" or "png" (default: "jpeg") |
| `name` | string | no | Name for the recording (default: "record"; also seeds the default filename stem) |
| `path` | string | no | Where the recording ZIP lands at stop (default: a timestamped record-<timestamp>.zip in the server's working directory, or ~/Documents/Vibium when that isn't writable) |
| `quality` | number | no | JPEG quality 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.5, ignored for png) |
| `screenshots` | boolean | no | Capture screenshots after each action (default: true) |
| `snapshots` | boolean | no | Capture HTML snapshots (default: false) |
| `sources` | boolean | no | Include source information (default: false) |
| `title` | string | no | Title shown in trace viewer (defaults to name) |
| `video` | boolean | no | Omit to record video when it can be had: the engine's screencast (Firefox 154+), or the device's screen stream on a station or Roadie session. Set true to require video — fails with an explanatory error on Chrome. Set false to disable. |
| `video_frame_rate` | number | no | Video frame rate (engine default if omitted) |
| `video_height` | number | no | Video height in pixels (defaults to the viewport) |
| `video_remote` | string: `keep` | no | On a remote browser connection, "keep" records anyway and leaves the video on the remote host; the stop result reports its remote path. Retrieval and cleanup are the caller's. |
| `video_width` | number | no | Video width in pixels (defaults to the viewport) |

### `browser_record_stop`

Stop recording and save to a Playwright-compatible trace ZIP file (with the video track when one was recorded). With upload, the ZIP also goes to the Record Store of the station the browser is connected through.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | no | Output file path (overrides the path declared at start; default: record.zip) |
| `upload` | boolean | no | Also upload the ZIP to the station the browser is connected through (its Record Store) and report its URL. Needs a remote connection with an API key; the file is saved locally either way. |

### `browser_record_start_group`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Name for the group |

### `browser_record_stop_group`

End the current recording group

No parameters.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | no | Output file path (default: chunk.zip) |
